title: Wildflowers Backport
body:
![Banner artwork.](https://gitea.micle.dev/minecraft-mods/wildflowers_backport/media/branch/1.20.1/main/assets/images/web/banner.jpg)

<details>
<summary>Disclaimer</summary>
All in-game textures/sounds are from 1.21.5 made by Mojang. I did not make them.
</details>

This mod simply brings the wildflowers from 1.21.5 to older versions. It works as similarly to the original as possible. It can be found in birch forests, old growth birch forests, and meadows.

# FAQ

<details>
<summary>Can I use this in my modpack?</summary>
Yes, go for it! Just make sure to use the appropriate source for your modpack (Modrinth/CurseForge).
</details>

<details>
<summary>Will this be ported to x.x.x version?</summary>
Feel free to open up a version port request on my issue tracker and I will see what I can do.
</details>
